purpose: Replay the early Level 01 high-walkway descent and isolate the handhold-to-vertical-connector route described by the natural Stage 1 movement sequence.

segments.input_family: left or right traversal from the loaded high-walkway-entry checkpoint, with C held or released during the descent
segments.result: Left reaches the x=1568 vertical connector; C held after attachment climbs to y=487. Right traverses the high walkway to x=2243. No scene transition occurs.
The delay-45 branch produces the exact 0x6A-to-0x6B handhold transition; other onset/direction variants either miss the alignment window or leave the actor without a completed grab.

C+Up+Left after the completed grab launches the player away from the handhold and then reattaches to the x=1568 vertical connector. The other branches fall to the lower floor or settle at the lower connector position.
Switching to Left before or after the completed grab does not produce the -0x0500 bounce. The branches either dismount to the lower floor or perform an ordinary jump; scene state remains 0x01.

interpretation.route_classification: The early high-walkway descent is the relevant Level 01 handhold route, distinct from the previously exhausted far-right upper shelf. Its actor-local 0x6A-to-0x6B transition is real and reproducible.
interpretation.what_is_closed: The tested Left/Right/Up/Down post-grab timing family does not produce the documented -0x0500 bounce or a scene transition.
interpretation.what_remains: The hidden ledge above the peddler and the final rightward exit route remain unresolved. The next search should branch from the positive top-of-connector checkpoint and trace the producer/consumer of the local 0x6A/0x6B actor rather than repeat the far-shelf probes.

conclusion: This campaign records the first positive reproduction of the early Level 01 handhold route: type 0x6A spawns during the high-walkway descent, becomes type 0x6B at the aligned C+Right grab, and the C+Up+Left continuation reaches the top of the x=1568 connector at world (1560,479). It is a route frontier, not a completed level exit.
